name: local_flow
description: Local only: review a Jira card, plan it, code it — one step at a time, with the card's memory kept on this laptop.

triggers.name: issue_key
triggers.description: The Jira card, e.g. BTS-41 (review, plan, memory).

triggers.name: answers
triggers.description: review: your answers to its questions, one per line or paragraph, each starting with its number — Q1: ...  Q2: ...  Kept for every later run; nothing is posted to Jira.

triggers.name: services
triggers.description: plan: the services to design for, e.g. ui (comma-separated, main one first). Empty: the ranking decides.

triggers.name: uploaded_files
triggers.description: review: a document with your answers (e.g. the review's Word report, answered). plan: the review report and any other files (optional). code: the TDD PDF (required). Several files can be picked.

triggers.name: branch_name
triggers.description: code: the new branch's name. Empty: fix/<card>-<number>.

triggers.name: target_branch
triggers.description: code: the branch the pull request goes into. Empty: the branch the TDD was written from.
